How GPT Image 2 pricing works

GPT Image 2 is billed per token: $8.00 per million input tokens (your prompt and any reference image) and $30.00 per million output tokens (the generated image). Output cost dominates in almost every real workload, so the quality parameter and the output size are the two levers that actually move the bill. All other parameters (output_format, output_compression, background, moderation) are free.
